completedPhases.summary: Working voice interview with OpenAI Realtime API

notes: Phase 2 nearly complete. Auth, DB, evaluation, results page all working. Only deploy remaining.
learnings: Realtime API uses ephemeral tokens (clientSecret) via /api/session — never expose OpenAI key to browser
AudioWorklet runs on audio render thread — postMessage with ArrayBuffer transfer (zero-copy) to main thread
PCM16 conversion: Float32 samples * 32768, clamped to [-32768, 32767]
Buffer audio at ~100ms (2400 samples at 24kHz) before sending to WebSocket — 128-sample chunks is too frequent
Scheduled playback: source.start(nextPlayTime) prevents audio delta overlap; advance nextPlayTime by buffer.duration
AudioContext lazy init in playAudioDelta means capture and playback share same 24kHz context
Evaluation rubric: 4 dimensions (Problem Scoping, Core System Flow, Reliability, Communication) with 1/3/5 behavioral anchors
Evidence before score: forces model to collect timestamped quotes before committing to a number — prevents gut-score rationalization
Temperature 0 for evaluation: removes score drift but not classification variance in free-form steps
Pre-scan + relevant_dimensions array: ensures early/scattered signals are not missed across dimensions
Transcript saved as jsonb on interview_sessions — simpler than separate rows for Phase 2; sufficient for evaluation and display
timestamp in TranscriptEntry is ms elapsed since interview start (not Date.now) — format to [MM:SS] at evaluation time
Evaluation fires and forgets after session save — results page polls every 3s until evaluation lands
Store raw evaluation JSON in DB alongside extracted scores — preserves rationale and evidence for display without re-calling LLM
trackA_complete: Clerk auth — /interview protected, userId attached to all sessions
DB schema: interview_sessions (transcript jsonb) + evaluations tables
POST /api/sessions — saves session + transcript as JSON
POST /api/evaluate — fetches transcript, calls OpenAI at temp 0, saves scores + rawResult
GET /api/sessions/[sessionId] — returns session + evaluation for results page
Results page /sessions/[sessionId] — polls for evaluation, shows scores, rationale, transcript
trackB_complete: Evaluation rubric: 4 dimensions with behavioral anchors
Prompt iterated for consistency (temperature 0, 3 runs identical)
Cross-dimension evidence via relevant_dimensions array fixed score undercount
Prompt stored in src/lib/prompts/evaluation.ts as buildEvaluationPrompt(topic)
nextSteps: Deploy to Vercel (Neon or Vercel Postgres for prod DB)
challenges: Audio deltas played simultaneously — fixed with scheduled playback queue (nextPlayTimeRef)
AudioWorklet firing too fast (187 msg/s) — fixed with 100ms buffer accumulation in worklet
LLM missed early evidence ([00:05]) — fixed with pre-scan step before dimension scoring
primary_dimension siloed cross-cutting statements — fixed with relevant_dimensions array + explicit filter instruction
timestamp_ms was integer (32-bit overflow) — changed to store ms-since-start as bigint, then dropped in favour of jsonb transcript
transcript_entries rows per message — replaced with single jsonb column on interview_sessions
Local postgres intercepting port 5432 before Docker — used local postgres directly via createdb
experiments: Evaluation prompt: 6 iterations from basic rubric to pre-scan + cross-dimension evidence; Reliability score moved from 4 to correct 5
roadmap: See AGILE_ROADMAP.md for full phased plan
